cases.question: Explain the difference between ACT action chunking and closed-loop feedback in three sentences.
cases.text: ACT action chunking involves breaking down a complex task into smaller, manageable sub-actions, allowing the agent to focus on completing one step at a time. Closed-loop feedback is a control mechanism where the system continuously monitors the outcome of an action and uses that information to adjust subsequent actions in real-time. Therefore, chunking is about task decomposition, while closed-loop feedback is about dynamic error correction based on observed results.
